user_story: As a booking officer, I want a weekly list of the next patients to book in clinical order, so that patients are treated in turn
acceptance_criteria: Given the GA list at the start of the week, when the worklist is generated, then patients are ordered by category (1, 2, 3) and then by days waited relative to target; and any manual change to the order requires a reason code

user_story: As a booking officer, I want to see whether a patient has a current pre-anaesthetic assessment, so that I arrange it before offering a theatre date
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient on the worklist, when the assessment is missing or older than 6 months, then the patient is flagged 'Assessment needed' and the flag clears when a valid assessment is recorded

user_story: As a booking officer, I want a short-notice pool of assessed patients who can attend at 48 hours' notice, so that cancelled slots are backfilled
acceptance_criteria: Given a cancellation within 7 days of a session, when I open the short-notice pool, then I see eligible patients for that clinic and session type in worklist order

user_story: As a waitlist officer, I want a queue of patients not contacted in 90 days, so that I can confirm they still need treatment
acceptance_criteria: Given the list, when a patient's last contact is more than 90 days ago, then they appear in the validation queue ordered by oldest contact first

user_story: As a waitlist officer, I want to record the outcome of each validation call with a standard reason code, so that removals are consistent and reportable
acceptance_criteria: Given a validation call, when I record the outcome, then I must choose one of: still requires GA; treated elsewhere; moved out of area; no longer requires GA; unable to contact (3 attempts); clinical change reported

user_story: As a senior dentist, I want patients who report a change in symptoms routed to me for re-triage, so that deterioration is picked up while they wait
acceptance_criteria: Given an outcome of 'clinical change reported', when it is saved, then a re-triage task is created for the patient's clinic within 2 business days

user_story: As a waitlist officer, I want the system to block removal for 'unable to contact' until three attempts on different days are logged, so that patients are not removed unfairly
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient with fewer than three logged attempts on separate days, when I select 'unable to contact', then the removal is blocked with a message

user_story: As a referring dentist, I want a structured triage checklist on the GA referral, so that the category reflects the statewide criteria
acceptance_criteria: Given a new GA referral, when it is submitted, then each criterion is answered and the suggested category is shown; an override of the suggested category requires a free-text reason

user_story: As the Director of Oral Health, I want a quarterly audit sample of categorisations, so that I can see whether criteria are applied consistently
acceptance_criteria: Given a quarter, when the audit is generated, then 30 random referrals per clinic are listed with category, override flag and reviewer field

user_story: As a senior dentist, I want a one-off review list of all Category 2 patients waiting more than 12 months, so that their category and clinical need are confirmed
acceptance_criteria: Given the list at go-live, when the review list is produced, then it contains every Category 2 patient with more than 365 days waiting; each must be marked confirmed, re-categorised or escalated

user_story: As the HHS Performance Unit, I want the share of patients waiting more than 12 months reported alongside % past target, so that performance is comparable across categories and HHSs
acceptance_criteria: Given a reporting period, when the report is produced, then both measures are shown by category and in total, using the published Queensland Health definitions

user_story: As the Director of Oral Health, I want monthly patients treated against patients added, so that I can see whether the list is growing before it shows in waiting times
acceptance_criteria: Given a month, when the report runs, then additions, removals by reason, treated and closing list are shown and reconcile to the change in list size

user_story: As the executive sponsor, I want a one-page view of progress against the backlog plan, so that I can decide on gate 2 funding
acceptance_criteria: Given the plan baseline, when the report runs, then actual vs planned overdue patients, extra cases delivered and spend to date are shown

user_story: As a clinic manager, I want reports limited to my clinic's patients, so that patient information is only seen by staff who need it
acceptance_criteria: Given a user assigned to a clinic, when they open any report, then only that clinic's patients are visible (row-level security); the Director sees all clinics

user_story: As the oral health information team, I want every list change logged with date, user and reason, so that the list can be audited
acceptance_criteria: Given any add, change of category or removal, when it is saved, then an audit record is written and cannot be edited
